author: Zintenka
body:
Yes yes yes, this is has been suggested many many times. But I never saw a dedicated post about this idea. The player counts have been changing and changing. However, right now we aren't going down but neither are we going up. We're stagnating. And eventually. if nothing is done we'll be reduced to a mere 50 or less players.

There are many bad things about this. But there are many good things about this.

Pros:
  • Tremendous boost in player count
  • Money for the server
  • Fame: More guests coming to check out the server
  • With continued donations comes more money to improve the server
  • "Fresh-meat" for us experienced players... Kerokerokero... 
  • With new players comes the potential to get a new batch of bright and coherent staff members. Even new Developers who want to offer their services for free.
Cons:
  • Staff will be hard-pressed handling reports
  • Server might overflow to extreme proportions (Also a pro. See top)
  • More player misconduct. (Depends on the youtuber.)
Despite the risks that this will cause. There is no other choice. Advertising the server will make us gain players very slowly. It might not even work. When people see a server with a low player count, they will most likely steer clear. So a youtuber is the better option. 

We need a high youtuber. A youtuber who will make sure that we get players. We need one with atleast +300,000 subscribers. Preferably 500,000 to 1,000,000... 

We need one who isn't arrogant, self-centered or too serious. We need one who acts Down-to-Earth and seems like they have their head on their shoulders correctly. Basically, we need a Youtuber who doesn't act like an aberration but gets a lot of attention and provides interesting videos.

Know anyone?

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
The server its self literally tells you "Destroy The Monument" and etc. If anyone played minecraft long enough, they'd know to craft armor from the various ore blocks.'

They can ask what they have to get. The game is very vanilla aside from the plugins and special YML stuff.  Hypixel has some "complicated" names for gamemodes and the way the games are played. Yet look at it's population. It's huge. 

So it's not about games being "Too complex" because the games are not. With enough time, you will get the basics. And its fun to learn on the way. 

I'd say what limits us is the lag. But other than that, there is nothing stopping new players from joining. We have a decent-mannered forum community who you can grow friendly with if you behave yourself and are active. (I came from OCN first but I prefer here because its more homely). We have an active staff team ready to assist with anything ranging from reports to - staff like me - maps. 

We may have our limitations, however, if you stay long enough you'll enjoy playing on this server.

Because a monument can be any block. That is why you ask what to do and/or use common sense; thats what I did when I first played OCN.

And what's so bad about doing so many things on a gamemode? In fact, its so exciting and it gives me an adrenaline rush... all those players just... slaughtering the hell outta each other... high player count... Hell yeaaahhh... Heheheh...

*Coughs* Hypixel has so many things to do yet its player count is huge. So you figure that people will eventually leave Hypixel for this reason?

Heck no.

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
My buddy did a study with YouTube advertising, Out of 74 people from all different likes and YouTube followers, a server will have to usually catch their attention in the first 9:36 minutes or they will usually leave. I mean yes I am a key logger please ban.

From what I have seen, there is no indication at all for what to destroy and I would have to observe for a while to get the game down pact till...another map appears.

If you were a new player and didn't know what to do because humans just jump into things. Running into experienced gamers and dying a lot doesn't sound fun. This game is a natural competition environment two. Meaning players are more active to rage on these types of servers if they do not perform as well as other players.

The problem is because of the lack of knowledge of the gamemode you will be doing stupid useless stuff like holding front lines or shooting people for ten minutes or more doesn't sound too thrilling for a new players. TDM is more thrilling because it is constant pvping and less building bridges and getting shot off all the time.

Hypixel has a lot of games, with different objectives so a player can spend longer time on that server. Avicus has three gamemodes that are not dead. CTW,TDM, and DTM. 

Now to fix your cough I would suggest getting cough drops or if that doesn't work do a native rain dance.
